# 2XceL Digital Media — Full Reference

> 2XceL Digital Media builds custom, high-converting websites with marketing engineered into the backend, deploys 24/7 AI sales agents, produces AI-generated cinematic ad content, and runs done-for-you marketing campaigns. Founded on the principle that media without marketing is invisible, and marketing without automation is inefficient. Led by Executive Director Christian Cométe. Tagline: Strategy, Automation, Growth. Service area: Worldwide.

## Mission

Led by Executive Director Christian Cométe, 2XceL Digital Media was founded on a simple truth: media without marketing is invisible, and marketing without automation is inefficient. The company equips brands for the Agentic Web by blending engineered backend technical automation with elite creative media, giving mid-market businesses and rising entrepreneurs the modern infrastructure they need to outpace the competition.

Four systems, one revenue engine: every service is engineered to generate pipeline, not just impressions.

## Services (Detailed)

### 1. Custom Web Design — Built to Sell
Fast, beautiful websites that turn visitors into leads and customers. Built with SEO, automation, and lead capture so the site works 24/7 to grow the business.
- Ranks high on Google search
- Captures leads automatically
- Lightning-fast load speeds
- Tracks every sale and visitor
Pricing: from $3,500.

Traditional business websites sit passively on the web like printed brochures. 2XceL engineers hand-coded, high-performance web frontends backed by real-time analytics, unbranded lead triggers, and automated database campaign conduits to convert visitors instantly.

### 2. AI Agents & Automations — Voice Agents, Lead Scrapers & More
AI agents, automations, and workflows for any business need, from voice agents to lead scrapers. Prebuilt agents can be tested directly on the site.
- Voice agents that answer calls 24/7
- Lead scrapers and prospect finders
- Automated email and follow-up workflows
- Custom chatbots for any business
Pricing: $350 per agent; free base templates available. Bundle of all 25 agents available at a discount.

The difference between a chatbot and a 2XceL agent is the verb: a chatbot answers; an agent reasons, decides, and acts. 2XceL agents turn raw AI capability into work — research, support, lead qualification, content drafting — running on 15+ frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and open-weight providers, with an Auto mode that picks the best model per request. Agents have persistent per-user memory, 34 built-in tools plus 100+ integrations and MCP support, and can be trained on your projects, files, URLs, and videos. Each is shareable via one public embeddable link.

25 prebuilt workplace agents span eight categories: Customer Support, Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Operations, IT & Dev, and Specialized. Example flagship: the Echo Customer Support Agent, a voice agent that resolves customer inquiries and escalations in real time, 24/7.

### 3. AI Video & Creative Content — Professional Content, Fast
High-quality video, product photos, and creative ads made with AI — no expensive shoots or long wait times. Cinematic content ready to post in days, not weeks.
- AI-generated product videos
- Professional photos and ads
- Custom branded content
- Social-media-ready assets
Pricing: from $1,500.

### 4. Done-For-You Marketing — Strategy That Converts
Full-service marketing: ad strategy, content creation, and audience targeting to build campaigns that bring in real customers, not just clicks.
- Custom marketing strategy
- Ad campaigns that convert
- Audience research and targeting
- Monthly performance reports
Pricing: from $2,000/mo.

## Pricing & Engagement

Build Your Own Plan: modular pricing where clients select core services and an AI agent pack, with the price updating live. No contracts, cancel anytime. Most setups go live in 2–4 weeks. Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute call, no obligation.

Subscription tiers:
- Tier 1: Complimentary Workspace Blueprints
- Tier 2: Core Growth & Implementation — $2,500
- Tier 3: Full Enterprise Infrastructure — custom pricing

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Won't an AI Sales Assistant sound robotic?
Absolutely not. 2XceL AI Sales Assistants do not run on static keywords. Using next-generation cognitive models, they adapt dynamically, parsing complex client intents, matching your exact brand tone with conversational elegance, and guiding users with professional confidence. They interact like an elite virtual executive.

### Can it handle custom operations?
Yes. 2XceL ingests your entire corporate database into a secure offline knowledge system — including rate sheets, project parameters, technical specs, and standard reply files. This lets the AI Sales Assistant address complex technical requests with precision, and escalate booking options to your human team only when leads are highly qualified.

### Is integration complex?
No. Integration takes less than an hour. The backend is designed plug-and-play. The AI Sales Assistant connects natively with CRM stacks (HubSpot, Salesforce), communication tools (Slack), and scheduling (Calendly), channeling validated leads and booked appointments straight to your pipeline without changing your workflow.

### Does it actually generate sales?
Yes. Static contact forms convert at an average of ~1.8%. 2XceL's live-qualifying dialogs regularly reach upward of 14.5% conversion rates by engaging visitors instantly at peak buying interest, converting late-night browsing into scheduled appointments automatically.
